cases.purpose: bashkmod list prints one 'name size refcnt deps state' row per /proc/modules line without the address column, and agrees with lsmod
cases.oracle: An independent Python parse of the live /proc/modules (first five columns) and kmod lsmod in the guest
cases.comparison: Row-for-row equality with the independent parse, and name/size/used-by equality with lsmod, on the guest's live module set (at least one module).
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t bashkmod) == builtin ]] || exit 125
bashkmod list >"$HOME/list.out"; rc=$?
/usr/bin/python3 -I - "$HOME/list.out" <<'PY'
import subprocess, sys
got = open(sys.argv[1]).read().splitlines()
want = [" ".join(l.split()[:5]) for l in open("/proc/modules")]
lsmod = [l.split() for l in subprocess.run(["/usr/sbin/lsmod"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.splitlines()[1:]]
rows = [r.split() for r in got]
ls = {r[0]: r for r in lsmod}
print("rows-nonzero=%d equal-to-proc-modules=%d columns-5=%d" % (len(got) > 0, got == want, all(len(r) == 5 for r in rows)))
print("names-equal-lsmod=%d size-equal=%d usedby-count-equal=%d" % (
    sorted(r[0] for r in rows) == sorted(ls),
    all(ls[r[0]][1] == r[1] for r in rows if r[0] in ls),
    all(ls[r[0]][2] == r[2] for r in rows if r[0] in ls)))
PY
echo "rc=$rc"
cases.stdout:
rows-nonzero=1 equal-to-proc-modules=1 columns-5=1
names-equal-lsmod=1 size-equal=1 usedby-count-equal=1
rc=0

cases.purpose: info NAME on a live module reports /sys/module/NAME coresize/initsize/initstate/refcnt/version and sorted parameters equal to the kernel values
cases.oracle: An independent Python read of /sys/module/NAME of the first live module (sorted by name) that exposes initstate and a parameters directory of regular files
cases.comparison: Candidate output compared line for line with the independent model for a live module chosen at run time; the chosen module must have initstate and parameters.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t bashkmod) == builtin ]] || exit 125
/usr/bin/python3 -I - <<'PY' >"$HOME/pick"
import os
for l in sorted(l.split()[0] for l in open("/proc/modules")):
    d = "/sys/module/" + l
    p = d + "/parameters"
    if os.path.isfile(d + "/initstate") and os.path.isdir(p) and os.listdir(p) and all(os.path.isfile(p + "/" + f) for f in os.listdir(p)):
        print(l); break
PY
read -r mod <"$HOME/pick" || exit 125
[[ -n $mod ]] || exit 125
bashkmod info "$mod" >"$HOME/info.out"; rc=$?
/usr/bin/python3 -I - "$mod" "$HOME/info.out" <<'PY'
import os, sys
mod, out = sys.argv[1:]
d = "/sys/module/" + mod
want = []
for f in ("coresize", "initsize", "initstate", "refcnt", "version"):
    try:
        v = open(d + "/" + f).readline().rstrip("\n")
    except OSError:
        continue
    want.append("%s=%s" % (f, v))
for f in sorted(os.listdir(d + "/parameters")):
    try:
        v = open(d + "/parameters/" + f).readline().rstrip("\n")
    except OSError:
        continue
    want.append("param.%s=%s" % (f, v))
got = open(out).read().splitlines()
print("lines-equal=%d has-initstate=%d has-coresize=%d has-params=%d" % (got == want, any(l.startswith("initstate=") for l in got), any(l.startswith("coresize=") for l in got), any(l.startswith("param.") for l in got)))
PY
echo "rc=$rc"

cases.purpose: info on a module that is not loaded fails with 'not loaded' status 1; invalid names are rejected; a non-directory entry is refused
cases.oracle: The builtin's documented messages and statuses (bash EX_USAGE maps to status 2), over the live /sys/module and a private BASHKMOD_SYS_MODULE_DIR
cases.comparison: Status and diagnostic for an absent module, a regular-file entry, five invalid names and a missing operand.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t bashkmod) == builtin ]] || exit 125
/usr/bin/mkdir -p sys; : >sys/afile
t() { local out; out=$("$@" 2>&1 >/dev/null); echo "[$*] rc=$? "; }
chk() { local label=$1 text=$2; shift 2; local out rc; out=$("$@" 2>&1 >/dev/null); rc=$?; echo "$label rc=$rc text=$([[ $out == *"$text"* ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"; }
chk absent-live "w6nomod not loaded" bashkmod info w6nomod
chk absent-private "not loaded" env BASHKMOD_SYS_MODULE_DIR=/tmp/parity-case/sys "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'bashkmod info w6nomod'
chk not-a-dir "not a module directory" env BASHKMOD_SYS_MODULE_DIR=/tmp/parity-case/sys "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'bashkmod info afile'
chk dotdot "invalid module name" bashkmod info ../etc
chk slash "invalid module name" bashkmod info a/b
chk dot "invalid module name" bashkmod info .
chk dotdot2 "invalid module name" bashkmod info ..
chk empty "invalid module name" bashkmod info ""
chk no-operand "info: NAME" bashkmod info
chk too-many "too many arguments" bashkmod info a b
cases.stdout:
absent-live rc=1 text=1
absent-private rc=1 text=1
not-a-dir rc=1 text=1
dotdot rc=2 text=1
slash rc=2 text=1
dot rc=2 text=1
dotdot2 rc=2 text=1
empty rc=2 text=1
no-operand rc=2 text=1
too-many rc=2 text=1
